title: Why This Bond Futures Trade Is Buying More Time
speaker: tastylive host (Five Minute Futures)

macro_themes.view: Bonds stopped falling despite hot CPI/PPI; yields above 5% attract buyers; Fed boxed in.
Semiconductor selling has coincided with lower yields; more Nasdaq selling supports bonds.
Creeping oil is a headwind for bonds.

calls.reason: Holding 106-107 call spreads and adding 108-109 long call spread (69 DTE); bonds stopped falling despite hot CPI/PPI; near 50-day MA resistance so allows for pullback.
calls.quote: CPI was hot. PPI was even hotter. And yet bonds, they finally stopped going down... I'm looking for a continuation to the upside.

notes: Ticker ZB = 30y T-bond futures price (inverse of TYX yield). 'This OPEX Friday' => Fri Oct 16 (listing Oct 19). price_at_call ~106 approximate (rally to near 106-107 long strike). Exit below 104.5.
